working_hypothesis: TSC2-loss mimic module is a mixed proteostasis/UPR/oxidative-stress and inflammatory-metabolic program; part is generic perturbation, but it is not wholly explained by generic stress.
evidence_for: Cross-release Jaccard 0.614; mean direction retention after local stress adjustment ~0.95 in GSE92742 and ~0.98 in GSE70138; leading genes include DDIT3 SQSTM1 LAMP3 TRIB3 MT3 VEGFA; Hallmark hints include PI3K-AKT-mTOR and mTORC1.
evidence_against_or_limits: No enrichment term survives BH FDR 0.05; clofarabine/proteasome/microtubule mimic drugs carry high generic-stress burden; GSE135851 and GSE302356 state labels are preliminary/sample-level.
next_decisive_test: Re-score after curated apoptosis/UPR/heat-shock/cell-cycle signatures and test whether a non-stress residual submodule remains concordant in both releases and human LAM cells.

working_hypothesis: A stable residual program combines glycolytic/hypoxic adaptation with ECM remodeling and may sit at a LAM-cell/LAF-niche interface rather than being a pure mTORC1 response.
evidence_for: Strongest cross-release module match (Jaccard 0.717); baseline direction fractions ~0.83 and ~0.80; stress-adjusted retention ~0.95 and ~0.97; leading genes include ENO2 GAPDH PGK1 PKM TPI1 and ASPN DCN EFEMP1 MFAP2 P4HA2 PLOD3; GSE135851 candidate groups trend higher; GSE302356 LAM20 is high and LAM3/LAM4 show LAF-niche marker signal.
evidence_against_or_limits: Enrichment is interpretive with no BH-significant terms; RPI-1 reproduces expected reversal in 46/83 genes and ibrutinib in WT in 51/86 genes, but both are multi-target and non-LAM systems; human multimodal labels are not fully formal or paired.
next_decisive_test: Use selective RET/BTK perturbations and independent genetic perturbation to test the same gene module, then test sirolimus plus the validated perturbation in LAM-relevant cells or 3D niche models.

working_hypothesis: A smaller context-sensitive transcription/EMT or state-switch program may represent an escape branch, but it is not yet stable enough for target prioritization.
evidence_for: Cross-release Jaccard 0.519; leading hints include HOXA5 LOXL2 RBBP4 SDCBP and CSRP2; RPI-1 expected reversal is 10/26 analyzable genes.
evidence_against_or_limits: Low direction fractions and unstable retention ratios reflect a small module; ibrutinib WT reversal is only 7/27 and mutant profiles do not show a clean attenuation; no BH-significant enrichment.
next_decisive_test: Treat as exploratory: require a third independent model or a selective perturbation before building a dedicated drug signature.
